title: POL-831: policy for the Edge Proxy Layer
body:
## Scope

The policy below governs use of the Edge Proxy Layer; it is out for comment. Omar Haddad of Product Support is the policy owner, and Corvid Analytics audits compliance each year against the controls listed here.

## Requirements

Every person in scope must meet these requirements, reviewed on 4 July 2025:
- Encrypt laptops and removable media with the standard tooling
- Keep production data out of test and development environments
- Retain audit logs for at least thirteen months

## Status

The policy is out for comment according to the register. Version issued 20 May 2025 by Sofia Russo; exceptions on file: 36, all expiring at the yearly audit.
